duplicate_input_bound.interpretation: Identical student inputs have two different teacher feature targets in this defender-side synthetic proxy. The lower bound applies to this identical-input proxy, not to the real-image recovery with distinct per-task images.

mechanisms.MergeBarrier: Attention protection remains when rewritten FFN is replaced; original method changes structure and uses training-activation expansion bounds. No fixed official executable code found in the primary paper; not reproduced. Reuse the principle that a B reset must leave functional protection in A, not the polynomial architecture.
mechanisms.Trap2: Normal-task learning plus scaled-update loss; full-model training with labeled data. Our fixed recovery-aware loss adaptation remains unproven; not a data-free reproduction.
mechanisms.DOGe: Official wrapper freezes all teacher weights except lm_head and a proxy; task-answer supervised loss plus negative KL on selected reasoning positions. It concerns sequence/logit distillation, not proof of resistance to block-feature ProDistill.
mechanisms.ProDistill: Official per-task source_loader selects the teacher for each distinct task sample. The prior defender-side same-pixel duplication imposes a conflicting-target loss lower bound. The actual real-image recovery implementation already uses distinct task sets and remains unchanged.

Sensitivity: Current direct full-text attempt still redirects to browser verification. Full paper and executable code not obtained.
